reader.requirement: After any unsuccessful START of a relative file (invalid key from an unsatisfied comparison under each relational operator, an absent optional file, a wrong open mode), the file position indicator must show no valid next record, so the next sequential READ is unsuccessful with I-O status 46 (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 e 1) until a successful positioning, in sequential and dynamic access.

edition-consulted.switches: ctx.Edition.SubscriptedClauseOperands (a subscripted KEY operand) and ctx.Edition as the diagnostic sink; compile-time only, nothing on the runtime FPI path

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|DialectBehavior over RelativeConnector.Start, KeyedConnector, FileConnector (Unsuccessful, InvalidateFilePosition, StartOpenModeGuard): no edition arm on the failure path; FileConnector.Edition is read only for the sharing facility and two named behaviours not reached by START.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb359_unsuccessful_read_start_position covers the invalid-key START followed by a sequential READ; the absent optional file and each relational operator's failure are not exercised

probes.printed: dynamic: A2 START = 3 -> 23, A3 READ NEXT ST=46, A3B READ NEXT ST=46; A4 START > 5 -> 23, A5 ST=46; A6 START NOT LESS 6 -> 23, A7 ST=46; A8 START >= 5 then READ NEXT ST=00 REC-5; sequential: B1 START = 9 -> 23, B2 READ ST=46; optional absent: C0 OPEN ST=05, C1 START -> 23, C2 READ NEXT ST=46
probes.expected: 46 on every sequential READ after an unsuccessful START; 00 after a successful START

OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.5e.1

reader.notes: Every failing exit of RelativeConnector.Start returns through FileConnector.Unsuccessful (StartFail is Unsuccessful('23')), which calls the KeyedConnector override of InvalidateFilePosition: FpiValid false and the 46 poison armed; only StartPositioned clears it. Probes at --std 85 and 2023 print identical lines.
reader.at-2023: st8a at --std 2023 prints the same lines

refuter.evidence: Attacked what the reader's st8a did not try: a failed START after a position had been established by a successful READ NEXT (must not continue from the old position), a random READ after a failed START (must re-establish the position), the implied EQUAL with no KEY phrase (GR2), START >= 0, and START on a file open OUTPUT and on a closed file (47, GR1). rf8a.cob at --std 85: Z0 ST=47 (INVALID KEY not taken); A1 REC-1, A2 INVALID ST=23, A3 ST=46; B1 ST=23, B2 random READ ST=00 REC-2, B3 READ NEXT ST=00 REC-3; C1 ST=23, C2 ST=46; D1 ST=00, D2 REC-1; E1 ST=47, E2 after reopen REC-1. All as the text requires. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.4 GR8  (║4.7.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR8'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.7.4 GR1  (║4.7.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR1'.
